title: DynamoDB connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One DynamoDB instance's settings (CN2 Task 14): a parallel Scan source (one split per segment) and a BatchWriteItem sink that retries UnprocessedItems, with conditional writes on an optional version attribute. The three credential fields are names of secrets in the namespace's secret store (D189), never the keys themselves.

endpoint_url.description: An endpoint other than the region's (a VPC endpoint, or an emulator in tests).

access_key_id.description: The name of the secret holding the access key id.

secret_access_key.description: The name of the secret holding the secret access key.

session_token.description: The name of the secret holding a session token (temporary credentials).

segments.description: Parallel Scan segments, one split each.

poll_interval_ms.description: Scan again this long after the last scan finished; without it the table is read once.

item_format.description: json (plain JSON; sets become lists) or dynamodb-json (lossless), for both directions.

version_attribute.description: Sink: a numeric attribute; each put replaces the stored item only when its version is higher.

key.description: Sink: the upsert key, the table's key attributes, partition key first; read from DescribeTable when omitted.

max_unprocessed_retries.description: Sink: retries of UnprocessedItems before the batch is throttled.
